earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE FOR MORE INFORMATION CONTACT:
highlights: Consolidated operating income increased 7% and adjusted operating income increased 8% for the quarter
Global Systemwide sales* increased 4% to over $38 billion for the quarter
Systemwide sales to loyalty members across 70 loyalty markets were $41 billion for the trailing twelve-month period and more than $11 billion for the quarter
Consolidated revenues increased 1% (1% in constant currencies).

quotes.text: McDonald’s delivered another quarter of global growth, with solid performance across much of our international business. In the U.S., we're encouraged by improvement as the quarter progressed following our intervention on value.
